components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority safe workflow action.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--primary); color: white; padding: 10px 14px; font: 650 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--focus) 78%, white); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or secondary review action.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); padding: 10px 14px; font: 650 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--surface); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--focus) 78%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); padding: 10px 12px; font: 400 14px/1.35 var(--font-sans); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--ink-muted); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--focus) 26%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A text-first state label with redundant dot marker.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; min-height: 26px; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--warning-soft); color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--warning) 78%, black); padding: 4px 9px; font: 650 12px/1.1 var(--font-sans); } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Evidence Reference
components.description: Selects a verified source page and quote.
components.html: <button class="ds-evidence" aria-pressed="true"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none"><path d="M5.25 6.25h13.5v11.5H5.25zM8.25 9.5h7.5M8.25 12.25h5.5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"/></svg>Page 1 evidence</button>
components.css: .ds-evidence { display: inline-flex; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--accent-soft); color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 82%, black); padding: 7px 10px; font: 650 12px/1.2 var(--font-sans); } .ds-evidence:hover, .ds-evidence[aria-pressed="true"] { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 15%, white); } .ds-evidence[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent) 55%, white); } .ds-evidence:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--focus) 78%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active Navigation
components.description: The current operational section in the product shell.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--primary-soft); color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 82%, black); padding: 10px 12px; font: 680 14px/1.25 var(--font-sans); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 10%, white); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--focus) 78%, white); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: MedBot should feel like a well-organized records workroom in bright daylight: crisp referral pages, precise annotations, and a single review stamp that means an accountable person has acted. The interface is quiet enough for long review sessions, but it makes evidence, uncertainty, and required actions unmistakable. This is a product surface, not a marketing canvas. Familiar controls, compact information hierarchy, and stable side-by-side review matter more than visual novelty. The system rejects chatbot styling, decorative SaaS dashboards, and any visual language that implies clinical decision-making.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence is always one interaction away from the proposed value.
White and near-white surfaces keep dense records readable in bright office environments.
Deep rose marks identity and primary action on less than ten percent of a screen.
Status is expressed with text, shape, and iconography in addition to color.
Motion is limited to fast state feedback, never page choreography.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Stamp Rule
rules.body: Review Stamp is used on no more than ten percent of a screen. Its rarity gives primary actions meaning.

rules.name: The Semantic Separation Rule
rules.body: Review Stamp is brand identity. Evidence Blue, Verified Green, Attention Amber, and Exception Red keep operational state distinct from brand.

rules.name: The Opaque Identifier Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for referral IDs, block IDs, and trace IDs. Patient-facing or reviewer-facing values stay in the sans family.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Persistent surfaces never float. If a standing panel needs a wide drop shadow to read, its structure is wrong.

dos: Do keep the source document and structured referral visible together on review-sized screens.
Do use 150ms to 220ms state transitions and provide a reduced-motion alternative.
Do expose loading skeletons, actionable empty states, safe error messages, and visible keyboard focus.
Do distinguish AI proposals, human-corrected values, verification state, and reviewer approval in text.
Do keep status controls familiar and require the backend to authorize every action.
donts: Don't build a generic chatbot or conversational AI interface.
Don't build a decorative SaaS dashboard around vanity metrics, gradients, glass effects, or oversized cards.
Don't imply diagnosis, urgency scoring, treatment advice, eligibility, or medical necessity.
Don't create a dense enterprise admin portal with inconsistent controls, hidden state, or ambiguous actions.
Don't add motion or decoration that competes with document review.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders, gradient text, nested cards, or card radii above 16px.
Don't place patient data, document text, or FHIR payloads in URLs, telemetry, logs, or error messages.
